tool_summary: Executes an npm package binary, downloading and running it on the fly if not already installed locally. A direct arbitrary-code-execution vector distinct from npm install.
platform_notes: npx behavior is consistent across Linux and macOS.

rules.description: The -y/--yes flag suppresses the confirmation prompt npx normally shows before downloading and running a package that isn't already installed, removing the last manual checkpoint before arbitrary code execution from the registry.
rules.reversible_note: Reversibility depends entirely on what the executed package does, which commandant does not inspect.

rules.description: Downloads (if needed) and executes an npm package's binary. This runs arbitrary code from the registry with the invoking user's privileges, distinct from and in addition to any install-time lifecycle scripts.
rules.reversible_note: Reversibility depends entirely on what the executed package does, which commandant does not inspect.
